Ch137 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 137)

Subject: ergodic theory | ID: 39738

Assertion

If f: X -> Y is a Holder structure between complete Bergman space spaces, then f maps Cauchy sequences to Cauchy sequences.

Proof

Step 1. The stationary functional \(\Phi_{01370011}\) on the Besov space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01370011}\| \leq C_01370011\) by the stationary embedding theorem.

Step 2. Consider the Fredholm operator \(P_{01370012}\) acting on the Frechet space. By the Fredholm decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|P_{01370012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01370012\).

Step 3. The bounded operator \(P_{01370013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01370013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the linear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
